lessonTitle: 32. Pyramids with equal base areas and heights have equal volumes
lessonTitleEnglish: Pyramids with equal base areas and heights have equal volumes
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Volumes of solids
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: Pyramids whose bases have equal areas and whose heights are equal have equal volumes.
stages.headlineEnglish: Pyramids whose bases have equal areas and whose heights are equal have equal volumes.

stages.headline: The reason: sections at the same distance from the apex have equal areas (Cavalieri's principle).
stages.headlineEnglish: The reason: sections at the same distance from the apex have equal areas (Cavalieri's principle).

stages.headline: A triangular prism splits into three pyramids of equal volume, so a pyramid has one third of the volume of the prism with the same base and height.
stages.headlineEnglish: A triangular prism splits into three pyramids of equal volume, so a pyramid has one third of the volume of the prism with the same base and height.
